pr_body:
Don't trim highlight snippet if number_of_fragments is 0

Closes  #101803
pr_title: Don't trim highlight snippet if number_of_fragments is 0 #101803
pr_comment: @mayya-sharipova would you be able to help with reviewing this PR?

@mayya-sharipova I've added the rest test file for the change. I'm not sure the about preceding number in the naming convention for the .yml files. I've added the case for `number_of_fragments > 0` and `number_of_fragments = 0`. Is a default case (where the param `number_of_fragments` isn't mentioned) also required? Also, I've used the same input as the original issue linked with this PR.
@mayya-sharipova I ran `./gradlew check` earlier in the day, and it ran for almost an hour, and I ended up exiting it. Is that expected?
@yashdamani Indeed `./gradlew check` runs long, we usually don't run it locally. We run `./gradlew precommit` and then applicable tests.

@yashdamani Are you are able to access CI build failures and see and correct tests that are failing? 

```
 ./gradlew ':server:test' --tests "org.elasticsearch.lucene.search.uhighlight.CustomUnifiedHighlighterTests.testRepeatPhrase" -Dtests.seed=512E5E4D03C679D1 -Dtests.locale=de-LU -Dtests.timezone=America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires -Druntime.java=21

./gradlew ':server:test' --tests "org.elasticsearch.lucene.search.uhighlight.CustomUnifiedHighlighterTests.testSmallSentenceBoundedBreakIterator" -Dtests.seed=512E5E4D03C679D1 -Dtests.locale=de-LU -Dtests.timezone=America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires -Druntime.java=21
```

@mayya-sharipova I can't access the builds. On clicking Details it asks me to sign in to buildkite. Should I sign up for it? Or does `./gradlew precommit` test for these and I can check it locally?

I'm running `./gradlew ':server:test'` now and checking checking all failing tests.

@yashdamani The test failures are only in `CustomUnifiedHighlighterTests`, so you can run:

 ` ./gradlew ':server:test' --tests "org.elasticsearch.lucene.search.uhighlight.CustomUnifiedHighlighterTests.*`
@yashdamani Please don't force push changes while PR is under review, as it is difficult to see the changes from the previous review.
@mayya-sharipova alright, will keep that in mind going ahead.

review_comment: I think we don't need to modify this test at all. This test is designed when there are 3 passages, which will not happen if number_of_fragments is 0. The only modification you can do is to add a `3` as a number of fragments. ```java CustomPassageFormatter passageFormatter = new CustomPassageFormatter("", "", new DefaultEncoder(), 3); ```
Got it. I was under the impression that both the testcases (where `numberOfFragments` is 0 and > 0) need to be written.
